BiblicalUsage: Pithom was one of the treasure cities Pharaoh made the Israelites build, named once in Exodus 1:11 alongside Raamses. It was built by slave hands under taskmasters, a store-city for the king who feared them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Pithom stands for every empire built on forced labour — God saw it, and He brought His people out.
